first_step_test: A single broad coil in its final position gives the learner a stable diameter and a clear opening for the hose end.

source.notes: Planned six-panel handmade graphite raster contact sheet; pending generation and saved-crop review.

final_elements.name: main hose coil
final_elements.description: Draw one broad oval hose loop, open at the lower right so the line can continue outward.

final_elements.name: inner coil edge
final_elements.description: Add a parallel inner curve around the loop to establish hose thickness without closing the outlet.

final_elements.name: hose tail
final_elements.description: Extend the open lower-right end into a short curved tail that rises toward the nozzle.

final_elements.name: nozzle grip
final_elements.description: Attach a small angled pistol-grip body to the tail with a narrow connector collar.

final_elements.name: spray head and trigger
final_elements.description: Add a flared head at the upper nozzle tip and a short trigger inside the grip.
